name: report-agent-state
description: Reports what this Claude Code session is doing, as `claude agents --json` shows it, by running a command with the state word.

reportCommand.title: Report command
reportCommand.description: The command and its arguments, one per item, run with the state word (working, waiting or done) appended as its last argument. Empty turns the mod off.

requireEnv.title: Required environment
requireEnv.description: Variable names. The mod runs only when the session's environment sets at least one of them. Empty always runs.
